differences.writeup_quote: This builds on the white-bear steering idea of Raman et al. (2026), rederived and validated here as a generic readout intervention.

rationale: Both documents treat Raman et al. (2026)'s white-bear steering as the source the method builds on and rederives, with the write-up stating this directly in its method narrative ('rederived and validated here') and the message confirming this by describing what the contribution file cites and claims. The message additionally reports a quantitative match of the captured direction norms to the paper's published values, a concrete overlap detail not present in the write-up, making the message's account of closeness to the source slightly richer but not materially contradictory.
